name: com.tcl.uilibray.pictureinpicture.service.VodFloatingService
description: When TCL VHall on-demand video is moved out of its page, this service places the player in a movable floating window and keeps its playback position. Tapping the window returns to the video.
disableEffect: On-demand video will not continue in a floating window after leaving its page; watching in the video page still works.
